verdict.rationale: The product documents saved tasks that can be launched from Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center. Once started, a run continues in the background with Dynamic Island status and resumes after connection drops. However, there is no first-party evidence of recurring schedules or event triggers that fire the agent unattended; any recurring scheduling would depend on the host platform's Shortcuts automations. Missing for 10: native recurring scheduling or trigger-based automation, evidence of fully unattended runs without user initiation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It runs in the background while it works; the Dynamic Island shows what it is doing.
Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can run saved tasks.
A lost board, hotspot or mirroring link pauses the run and resumes it from the same step.
